user.title: Mazda 6e & CX-6e
user.description: Set up your Mazda 6e or CX-6e account (the MAZDA 6e & CX-6e app account). Sign in with the email and password of the app, or request a verification code by email.

data_description.login_method: Email and password signs in directly; email verification code sends a one-time code to the account email.

email_password.title: Email and password
email_password.description: Select the sales country registered in the Mazda app and enter the account credentials. Home Assistant stores the session tokens, never the password.

data_description.country: Sales country of the account, for example Spain. It is sent as selectcountry and salesCountry.
data_description.email: Email used in the Mazda app. It is encrypted before it is sent.
data_description.password: Password used in the Mazda app. It is encrypted before it is sent and is never stored.

intl_email.title: Email login
intl_email.description: Select the sales country registered in the Mazda app and the account email. Home Assistant will request a verification code.

data_description.country: Sales country of the account, for example Spain. It is sent as selectcountry and salesCountry.
data_description.email: Email used in the Mazda app. It is encrypted before it is sent.

intl_email_code.title: Email verification code
intl_email_code.description: Enter the verification code that was sent to the email address.

data_description.auth_code: Numeric code from the email. It expires quickly; request a new one if it is rejected.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Mazda API.
error.too_many_codes: Too many verification codes requested. Wait and try again.
error.account_not_registered: This account is not registered for the selected country.
error.bad_code: The verification code is invalid or has expired.
error.no_vehicles: The account has no vehicles linked.
error.wrong_account: This account does not own the configured vehicle.

init.title: Mazda 6e & CX-6e options

data.enable_mqtt_controls: Enable experimental remote controls for MQTT vehicles

init.description: Tune polling and diagnostics. The control PIN enables signed remote commands; the diagnostic options change how the API sees the client and should only be touched while troubleshooting.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant polls the vehicle when no MQTT telemetry is available, in seconds (30-3600).
data_description.control_pin: Remote-control PIN from the Mazda app. Required to lock/unlock, move the windows or open the trunk; it is exchanged for a token that expires periodically and is asked for again when that happens.
data_description.enable_api_logging: Write every API request and response to the Home Assistant log, with tokens, keys, VIN, email, PIN and serial number redacted. Enable only while troubleshooting.
data_description.enable_mqtt_controls: Allow remote commands for MQTT-backed vehicles. Experimental: MQTT command sending is not verified yet.
data_description.os_version: Android version declared in the x-os-version header. The default (9) matches the verified Changan capture; change it only to diagnose requests rejected by the gateway.
data_description.environment: Regional gateway set used for the Mazda API. EU production by default; preproduction targets the UAT gateways.
